description: Estimated Resident Population is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Bureau of Statistics. Statistics about the population and components of change (births, deaths, migration) for Australia and its states and territories provided by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS). Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
